verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships Resolve, an AI agent that takes a production error, writes a tested fix and opens a pull request for review. It also has user-configured, event-triggered rules that run without user input: alerts, webhooks and PagerDuty incident create/update/resolve. However, the evidence does not show Resolve being configured to run unattended in the background, or any general user-defined automation or workflow builder. Missing for 10: documented background/scheduled triggering of the Resolve agent, a general user-defined automation or workflow builder, and hands-on or independent corroboration of autonomous operation.
